pages.title: Analog Black Hole
pages.text: A condensate flowing faster than its own speed of sound: a horizon that sound cannot cross back over - and, at it, Hawking radiation of phonons.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Feed it Bose-Einstein Condensate and keep it below 5 K. Set the density, the flow, and the laser step: the flow must be subsonic before the step and supersonic after it. The Hawking temperature, ħκ/2πk_B, must stand out of the condensate's own warmth over enough shots - only Bose-Einstein Condensate as the coolant is cold enough.

pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
